blocks.text: After breakfast, take a boat trip along the Amazon River, with piranha fishing, a visit to Caboclo residents and a jungle walk to learn about the flora, fauna and survival skills. A programme with pink river dolphins is also scheduled for this day. Excursions in Manaus are shared tours with an English-speaking guide; the form of contact with animals is confirmed when booking.
